title.narrative: Laos - Enhancing Accountable and Participatory Governance in Laos

description.narrative: The programme’s focus is on strengthening Laos’ legislatures with a specific focus on increasing representation of citizen voices in government decision-making at the provincial and national level. This will be achieved by introducing effective and inclusive concepts and practices that can enhance accountable policy- and law-making.
